strings.subtitle: — Senyehi sa faele —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ho hula le ho tlohela ha ho fumanehe. Sebelisa konopo e ka tlase.
strings.ft_lnk: Tsela e kgutshwane (.lnk) — e tla hanngoa
strings.shred_button: S E N Y E H A
strings.ssd_warning:
Temoso! Ho SSD, mokhoa wa ho ngola hodimo ha o netefatse ho senyeha ka lebaka la TRIM.
Lenaneo lena ke la HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faele "{name}" e tla ngolwa hodimo mme e hlakolwe.

Tswela pele?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Sena ke sekgotla-tswelopele (.lnk). Ke sekgotla-tswelopele feela se tla senngwa.

Faele eo e e supang e tla dula e bolokegile.

Tsoela pele?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Sena ke draefe ya neteweke (\\server\share).
Ho ngola hodima dikarolo ha ho netefatse ho senngwa — seva e ka ba le disnapšoto, deduplication kapa CoW.

Tsoela pele?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Sena ke draefe e tlosoang (USB / HDD ya kantle).
Molaodi o ka boloka dipoloko tsa kgale ka polokelong.

Tsoela pele?
strings.dont_ask_again: O se ke wa botsa hape
strings.dont_show_again: O se ke wa bontsha hape
strings.error_cannot_read:
Ha e kgone ho bala faele:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  FAELE E NGOTSWE HODIMO E HLAKOTSWE
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mela ya data e meng (ADS) ha e sebetsoe.
• Koranta ya USN ha e hlatsuoe.
• Dikopi tsa seriti le dibapisi tsa leru
  (OneDrive jj.) ha di amehe.
strings.step_delete: Ho hlakola ho feta moqomo wa matlakala
strings.status_full: Dikahare di ngotswe hodimo ka botlalo ka lefela. Ho kgutlisa ha ho kgonehe — disebediswa di tla bona lefela feela.
strings.status_fast: Hlooho, mohatla le mela ya 4 MB di ngotswe hodimo. Tse ding ha di a ameha, empa ka lebaka la makgohlo, ho kgutlisa ka botlalo ke disebediswa tsa bareki ha ho kgonehe. Bakeng sa ditokomane tsa lekunutu, sebedisa mooki O FELLETSE.
strings.status_empty: Faele e ne e le lefela, ho ngola hodimo ha ho a hlokahala. E hlakotswe.
strings.error_permission: Ha e kgone ho fihlela faele. E ka ba e butswe ka lenaneong le leng. E kwale mme o leke hape.
strings.error_not_found: Faele ha e a fumanwa. E ka ba e se e hlakotswe.
strings.error_is_symlink: Sena ke link ya letshwao. Dikgokahano ha di kgone ho senngwa — faele eo e e supang e tla dula e bolokegile.
strings.error_reparse: Sena ke faele ya sebaka (OneDrive kapa e tshwanang). Datha ya yona e bolokilwe ka leru, e seng ka disikeng — ha ho na seo se ka senngwang mona.
strings.error_not_file: Sena ha se faele (foledara kapa se sengwe). Lahlela faele.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faele ena e na le hard link tse ding ({n} kaofela). Hard link ha di na ya pele — mabitso ohle a a lekana. Ha o ka senya ka tsela ya hajoale, datha e tla ngolwa hodima yona mme e kgolofatswa ho 32 bytes, empa masalla a tla dula a fihleleha ka dikgokahano tse ding. Hlakola dikgokahano tsohle pele.
strings.error_compressed:
Faele e kgateletswe, e patilwe kapa e sparse. Ho ngola ka zero ha ho netefatse ho senngwa ha datha ya kgale hobane NTFS e e boloka ka tsela e fapaneng.

Tlosa seka: tobetsa ka letsohong le letona → Dipharephare → E tsoetseng pele → tlosa letshwao la 'Kgatella' le/kapa 'Patela'. Jwale baka SHREDDER hape.
strings.queue_title: MOKGWA WA HO HLAKOLA KA BONGATA
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Ho ema ka mor'a faele ya hajoale...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Difaele tse {count} di tla senngwa.
Boholo kaofela: {size}.

Hlahloba lenane pele o tsoela pele.
Ketso ena e ke ke ya fetolwa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Tlosa difaele kaofela tse {count} moleng?

Difaele ka botsona DI KE KE tsa tshwarwa — lenane feela.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faele "{name}" e na le hard link tse ding ({nlink} kaofela).

Datha e tla senngwa bakeng sa mabitso ohle.
Empa masalla (32 bytes) a tla dula tlas'a mabitso a mang ka foledeng.

O ka nna wa hloka ho hlakola masalla ana ka letsoho.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Sebelisa ho hard link tsohle moleng
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: ha e kgone ho bala boholo
